A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''Sith acolyte''' served under [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Xedrix]] and, alongside [[Unidentified male Sith acolyte|another apprentice]], went with her [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] to [[Bosthirda/Legends|Bosthirda]] in [[3954 BBY]], where they were all [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]].

==Personality and traits==
The acolyte deeply cared for the other acolyte, and Scourge used it against them.
